tools.name: fed_funds_rate_today
tools.description: The current federal funds target range set by the FOMC, the effective federal funds rate (EFFR) for the latest business day with its change and volume, the prime rate (top of the range plus 3 points), and the last Fed rate change with every change in the last 3 years.

tools.name: sofr_rate_today
tools.description: The latest Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) with the change from the previous business day, percentiles and volume, the 30, 90 and 180 day SOFR averages and SOFR Index (used to price SOFR loans), and the other New York Fed reference rates: TGCR, BGCR, OBFR and EFFR.

tools.name: interest_rate_history
tools.description: History of one reference rate between two dates (up to 5 years per call): start, end, change in basis points, high, low and average, with a daily or sampled table. Rates: sofr, effr, obfr, tgcr, bgcr, sofr_30day_average, sofr_90day_average, sofr_180day_average, sofr_index, fed_funds_upper, prime. EF

tools.name: fed_rate_changes
tools.description: Every change to the federal funds target since a date (default the last 5 years, back to 2000): the date it took effect, cut or hike, basis points, the new target range and the prime rate after it. Answers "when did the Fed last cut rates".

tools.name: loan_rate_calculator
tools.description: The all-in variable rate today for a loan priced at an index plus a margin, such as an SBA 7(a) loan at prime + 2.75, a business line of credit at prime + 1 or a commercial loan at 30-day average SOFR + 2.5, with an optional floor or cap and the monthly payment for an amount and term.
